app_description.message: Choose website language and browser settings explicitly, with local site profiles.

standalone_description.message: Your profiles are stored in this browser. Connection to the NRR application is not available in this version.

broader_profile.message: A broader saved profile matches this site: $HOST$, $VALUE$. Saving a manual language or browser default creates an exception.

scope_inherited.message: Remove the saved profile for $VALUE$. The nearest broader site profile or global profile will apply.

language_tag_help.message: For example, fr, en-US or ru. Choose one language.

language_partial.message: Changes Accept-Language for requests whose destination host matches the profile. Resources from other hosts are outside that profile. Page scripts retain the browser language (navigator.language). Sites may use account or cookie preferences instead.

timezone_unavailable.message: Browser default · changing it is unavailable

webrtc_owned.message: Non-proxied UDP restricted for this browser profile

explicit_only.message: Browser settings change only when you explicitly apply an option. Installing or opening the extension does not enable these changes.

pending_changes.message: Saved changes have not finished applying. Check the result before relying on them.

saved_reload.message: Saved. Reload matching pages for new HTTP requests to use this choice.

inherited_reload.message: The explicit profile was removed. The broader site profile or global profile now applies. Reload the page.

inherit_confirm.message: Remove this explicit profile? The nearest broader site profile or global profile will apply to its scope.

unsupported_page.message: Open an HTTP or HTTPS website

open_website.message: Browser pages and extension pages cannot have a website profile. Global settings are available in Settings.

global_description.message: Used for websites without an explicit profile. Route-based NRR profiles will be available with the desktop connection.

scope_global.message: Scope — all HTTP and HTTPS websites in this browser profile.

hostname_help.message: Enter a hostname such as meet.example.com, without a URL path or port.

system_override_help.message: Browser default stops language inheritance for this scope. Removing the profile restores inheritance.

profile_precedence.message: The most specific matching hostname wins. Each profile shows whether it also includes subdomains.

no_profiles.message: No site profiles yet. Websites use the global browser profile.

webrtc_title.message: WebRTC for the whole browser profile

webrtc_scope.message: This change affects every website in this browser profile, including other tabs. Incognito windows may inherit it too.

webrtc_consequence.message: Restricting non-proxied UDP can interrupt calls and screen sharing. Applying the browser setting does not prove which network route a call uses.

webrtc_acknowledge.message: I want to apply this change to the entire browser profile and understand that calls may stop working.

webrtc_unavailable.message: WebRTC control is unavailable for this browser in this version.

webrtc_confirm_required.message: Confirm the whole-browser scope and its effect on calls before applying.

webrtc_saved.message: WebRTC setting applied to this browser profile. Check any ongoing calls.

webrtc_restored.message: The extension released its WebRTC setting.

error_generic.message: The result could not be confirmed. Reload this view and review the current settings before trying again.

webrtc_drift.message: Restriction requested, but the browser is not applying it. Check permissions and other extensions before applying again.

error_unavailable.message: The extension background is unavailable. Reopen this window.

error_invalid_host.message: Enter a valid hostname without a URL path, credentials or port.

error_invalid_language.message: Enter one valid language tag, such as fr or en-US.

error_invalid_state.message: The profile state is invalid. Reload the view before editing.

error_storage_corrupt.message: Saved profiles could not be read safely. They have been preserved for recovery.

error_storage_failed.message: The browser could not save the changes. Free storage space and try again.

error_conflict.message: Another window changed the profiles. Reopen this view and review the latest values before saving.

error_permission_required.message: Website access is required for this scope. Apply again and grant access when prompted.

error_permission_denied.message: Browser permission was declined. The change has not been applied.

error_unsupported.message: This setting is not supported in this browser.

error_route_unavailable.message: An NRR route is unavailable. Choose the browser default or a manual language.

error_consent_required.message: Review the scope and explicitly apply the change.

error_apply_failed.message: The browser refused the change. Check permissions and other extensions controlling this setting.

error_policy_unavailable.message: The profile engine could not load. Reinstall the complete extension package.

error_too_many_profiles.message: The profile limit has been reached. Remove an unused profile first.

error_untrusted_sender.message: The request did not come from this extension's settings.
